answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared bridge contract before it can trade, and let reputation accumulate slowly on a public terrace of past work: one verified delivery at a time, with slashing for fraud. A flood of fresh identities then faces a real tide - each fake must pay its own stake and wait out the same slow climb, so creating a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes and months of idle time, while one honest agent keeps its history and keeps earning.
